**Findings**

| Gene | UniProt | Length | Mass |
|---|---|---|---|
| GPX1 | P07203 (GPX1_HUMAN) | 203 aa | **22.088 kDa** |
| TMEM33 | P57088 (TMM33_HUMAN) | 247 aa | **27.978 kDa** |

TMEM33 is heavier (27.978 kDa vs 22.088 kDa for GPX1).

**Important data caveat:** The reviewed UniProt entry P57088 for TMEM33 is internally inconsistent. Its header and `length`/`molWeight` fields state **185 aa / 20,984 Da**, but the actual sequence deposited in the record is **247 aa**. I verified via CRC64 (`392A53377511A6A0`) and MD5 checksums that the stored sequence is the 247-aa one, and NCBI RefSeq NP_060596.2 independently confirms 247 aa. The 185-aa metadata is stale/incorrect. Using the 185-aa figure would have wrongly made TMEM33 (20.98 kDa) lighter than GPX1 (22.09 kDa), so resolving this discrepancy was decisive for the answer.
